name: Ezaki Riko
source:
The Heroine's Friend.

Like her close friend Hana, Riko is also a third-year high school student.

She is full of energy and is the complete opposite of Hana.

Unfortunately, she can be quite stubborn, so she doesn’t give up easily when she sets her mind on something (like convincing Hana to participate in the school's Valentine Day event for their last year of high school).

[From [url=http://twinproject.weebly.com/chocolate-cage.html]Twin Project[/url]]

*Important Note:
In-game, Riko is shown without a physical sprite. But Riko is depicted by the original creator, Kojima to have shoulder-length hair with brown hair and green eyes. An example of this can be found under the CG Gallery under "Extra Art" in the Ren'Py Port. This was most likely the intended appearance of Riko by the original creator.
